question: TPVS is related to LHNK in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, WSYV is related to OKQN. To which of the following options is RNTQ related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

TPVS is related to LHNK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ee9556b8fc10eb05e1dd70129aac48d74a76fb918d9b7c5ac10929622428bf4.png] 

WSYV is related to OKQN.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f64e904f57c2ee0512105c319b5369d46f1f7bf07b944a5403a8d7c4a7a4553.png] 

Similarly, RNTQ will be related:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b4647936fe8803350d7c671b0d4a6a2cc49a521359a7839edb216ef9ef51c39.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**JFLI**".
